التهمتما (form VIII)
# اِلْتَهَمْتُمَا (iltahamtumā) /il.ta.ham.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# اُلْتُهِمْتُمَا (ultuhimtumā) /ul.tu.him.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
